newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade moderate for a brief period midmorning, otherwise slow. Slaughter steers and heifers steady to 1.00 lower.

Inquiry moderate, demand light. Sales confirmed on 23,000 slaughter steers and 18,200 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 63,700 head, volume includes 16,300 head of previously contracted and formulated cattle.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1260 lbs 65.00- 66.25, mostly 66.00; mostly Select, few Choice 1150-1350 lbs 65.00-65.50.

Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1020-1260 lbs 65.00-66.25, mostly 66.00; mostly Select, few Choice 975-1050 lbs 64.50-65.50; few mixed Commercial to Choice heifers and heiferettes 1150-1175 lbs 61.00- 64.00.
Week to date 63,700 last week 63,500 last year 47,400.
